name: Masonry
description: Responsive masonry image grid with spring-based reveal animation, drag-to-reorder, hover effects, captions and an animated fullscreen lightbox with keyboard navigation.
contents: Absolutely positioned image tiles laid out in shortest-column masonry order
Optional title and description captions over each image
Fullscreen lightbox with backdrop, close, previous and next buttons, and caption with Open link
behavior: Columns computed from container width, either a fixed count or auto from columnWidth
Tiles reveal with a spring animation from a chosen direction, optionally with blur-to-focus, staggered, on scroll into view
Hover effects: zoom, lift, tilt toward the pointer, or none; optional dimming of other tiles on hover
Mouse users can drag tiles to reorder; layout reflows live and onReorder fires on drop
Optional parallax shift of images while scrolling
Clicking a tile opens a lightbox that animates from the tile; Escape closes, arrow keys step
Removed items animate out as ghosts; reduced-motion preference disables animation
Images without a height are measured by preloading, with a 2.5s fallback
editableByProps: Images, links, titles, descriptions, alt text, sizes and column spans through items
Column count or auto column width, gap and corner radius
Reveal direction, stagger, duration, bounce and blur
Hover effect, focus dimming, caption mode and parallax strength
Lightbox and drag-to-reorder toggles, click and reorder callbacks

needsCodeEdit.change: Change lightbox backdrop color or controls styling
needsCodeEdit.where: BOX_BACKDROP, BOX_CLOSE, BOX_PREV and BOX_NEXT constants

needsCodeEdit.change: Change caption gradient or text styles
Change lightbox Open link label or aria labels
needsCodeEdit.where: The lightbox block inside createPortal, text 'Open', 'Close', 'Previous', 'Next'

fixed: Default items is an empty array, so nothing renders until items are passed
Requires the packages @hugeicons/react and @hugeicons/core-free-icons for lightbox icons
Root height is set by JS from the layout, and width follows the parent, which must have a defined width
Lightbox renders in a portal on document.body at z-index 1000 and sets overflow hidden on the html element while open, restoring it on close
Adds window pointer listeners during drag and scroll or resize listeners for parallax, and removes them on cleanup
Dragging is disabled for touch pointers, and tap opens the lightbox instead
Hover effects and hover captions need a pointer, and on touch the hover caption mode stays hidden, so use captions always for touch
Lightbox uses hardcoded padding of 72px, or 16px below 640px viewport width
Needs a browser environment: uses ResizeObserver, IntersectionObserver and Web Animations API
